descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · S03 「同样的十句话走恢复引擎（whisper-1，Recover 路径）」 Same ten sentences through the recovery engine (whisper-1, the Recover path)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Dictated numbers (doses, lab values, vital signs) are transcribed exactly: same value, nothing dropped, added or changed.（UAT TC-23；TFA-94423 AC 3）
  • U2 Drug names are transcribed correctly or visibly flagged when uncertain.（UAT TC-23；TFA-94423 AC 4）
  • U3 A dictated Celsius temperature stays in Celsius: no conversion to Fahrenheit, no change of unit.（UAT TC-23；TFA-94423 AC 5）
  • U5 The speech-to-text engine used is recorded for every run (GPT-Live streaming; Deepgram only when the ambient option is on), alongside the note model.（UAT TC-23；UAT 3.9；TFA-94423 AC 7）

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given The S01/S02 speech audio with no lead-in silence, transcoded to webm/opus (ffmpeg -c:a libopus) like the MediaRecorder recording the app keeps (it starts recording when the session opens), or the blob the app itself saved in S25 / S08 E-4; signed-in fresh account; …

When Each clip is posted to ai/transcribe:transcribeAudio with mimeType audio/webm, as the 'Recover note recording' button and the automatic recovery do

Then The returned text passes the same per-sentence checks as in S01/S02 (numbers, boundaries, occurrences); each call is logged as transcribe.transcribeAudio with model whisper-1

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Same per-sentence checks and 9/10 bar as S01/S02: a recovered transcript is what the physician reads after an interrupted take. Whether a whisper-1 transcript counts toward TC-23 is Q6. Unit test 'under the live route a saved recording is transcribed by the same vendor's batch model, and the log says so' (e2e/unit/live-session-action.unit.ts, unit config) already checks the ro …

在哪跑：本地 aicheck-dictation（口述 AI 检查）；测试方法 AICHECK · AI 输出检查；矩阵里排的车道 AI 检查（automated）

S03 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-23.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：测试问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-94423 ready for qa

还没判：走 whisper-1 恢复路径的转写卡在同一个本地 OpenAI key 许可上。

Not judged yet: transcription through the whisper-1 recovery path is blocked on the same local OpenAI key approval.

依据：allure-results/1204f6e7…: the whisper-1 batch run is built and its --dry run validated 10+4 clips; blocked by the same key precondition.

重复：和 TC-23/S01 是同一个问题，看那条（保留的）；这条带标签「重复」，筛选时可以去掉。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane aicheck-dictation。

测试方法：AICHECK · AI 输出检查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：aicheck-dictation。

Built: 10 webm/opus clips (no lead-in silence) posted as {audio: $bytes, mimeType: 'audio/webm'} to ai/transcribe:transcribeAudio, S01/S02 checks, transcribe.transcribeAudio/whisper-1 rows; --dry run validated the 10 + 4 clips (no call made).
